description: CrowdSec: blocked requests, alerts, decisions, WAF, log parsing, LAPI and runtime.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: CrowdSec components up and bouncers streaming decisions. Any missing is DEGRADED; none is DOWN.

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: Requests the bouncer refused in the selected range.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Alerts raised in the selected range by scenarios and WAF rules.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time((sum by (reason) (clamp_min(cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} - cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m, 0) or ((cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} unless cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"$job"} offset 1m == 1))))[$__range:1m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active bans
panels.description: Bans in force now, including community and subscribed blocklists.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests the bouncer checked in the selected range.

panels.title: Added latency
panels.description: Average time the bouncer adds to each request in the selected range.

panels.title: Blocked per hour
panels.description: Requests the bouncer refused each hour, by what stopped them.

panels.title: Blocked per day
panels.description: Requests the bouncer refused each day, last 14 days.

panels.title: Alerts per hour
panels.description: Alerts raised each hour by scenarios and WAF rules.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time((sum by (reason) (clamp_min(cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} - cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m, 0) or ((cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} unless cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"$job"} offset 1m == 1))))[$__interval:1m] offset -$__interval)) > 0

panels.title: Alerts by scenario
panels.description: Alerts in the selected range by scenario or WAF rule, most first.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_replace(sum by (reason) (sum_over_time((sum by (reason) (clamp_min(cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} - cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m, 0) or ((cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} unless cs_alerts{job=~"$job"} offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"$job"} offset 1m == 1))))[$__range:1m])), "short", "$1", "reason", "(?:[^/]+/)?(.+)") > 0))

panels.title: Added latency by step
panels.description: Average time per request to look up bans, and to inspect it in the WAF.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Requests the bouncer checked.

panels.title: Bans by reason
panels.description: Bans in force now by the behaviour, blocklist or scenario behind them.

panels.title: Bouncer sync
panels.description: Whether the bouncer's decision stream is connected, and time since it last synced.

panels.title: WAF hits by rule
panels.description: WAF rules that matched a request in the selected range.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_replace(sum by (rule_name) (increase(cs_appsec_rule_hits{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cs_appsec_rule_hits{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by (rule_name) ((min_over_time(cs_appsec_rule_hits{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) unless cs_appsec_rule_hits{job=~"$job"} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cs_appsec_rule_hits{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)), "short", "$1", "rule_name", "(?:[^/]+/)?(.+)") > 0))

panels.title: Whitelisted by reason
panels.description: Log events a whitelist dropped in the selected range, by reason.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (reason) (increase(cs_node_wl_hits_ok_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cs_node_wl_hits_ok_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by (reason) ((min_over_time(cs_node_wl_hits_ok_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) unless cs_node_wl_hits_ok_total{job=~"$job"} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cs_node_wl_hits_ok_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)) > 0))

panels.title: Log lines per hour
panels.description: Log lines read each hour, split by whether a parser understood them.

panels.title: Processing time
panels.description: Average time to parse a log line and to match it against scenarios.

panels.title: Calls by route
panels.description: Calls the LAPI served in the selected range, by route.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_join(sum by (route, method) (increase(cs_lapi_route_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cs_lapi_route_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by (route, method) ((min_over_time(cs_lapi_route_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) unless cs_lapi_route_requests_total{job=~"$job"} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cs_lapi_route_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)), "call", " ", "method", "route") > 0))

panels.title: LAPI response time
panels.description: Average time the LAPI takes to answer a call.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU per CrowdSec component, as a share of one core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory per CrowdSec component.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines per CrowdSec component. Growth with steady traffic points to a leak.
